newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM'S AVIAPARTNER EXPANDS IN FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM'S AVIAPARTNER EXPANDS IN FRANCE.

text.p: Belgian airport services group AviaPartner said on Thursday it took control of Marseille, France, based Assistair, extending its French network.
Assistair employs 300 people and had 1996 turnover of 74 million French francs.
AviaPartner with staff of 4,000 and turnover of 6.5 billion Belgian francs, was already present at the airports of Lyon, Lille, Toulouse, Nantes and Basle-Mulhouse.
AviaPartner said in the statement it intended to expand further in Europe. It gave no financial details of the takeover.
